assumptions: Every high-risk runtime feature remains false by default.
This fixture is policy evidence and not a production assurance claim.

threats.title: Account takeover and authority escalation
threats.scenario: A synthetic attacker replays a session or obtains a role outside its scope.

controls.description: Route and domain policy deny invalid sessions, roles, scopes, and replay.

residualRisk.explanation: Production providers and representative authority workflows are not approved.

threats.safeDegradation: Deny account and authority commands while preserving anonymous public reads.

threats.title: Precise location or private civic activity leakage
threats.scenario: Restricted synthetic data reaches logs, analytics, public output, or another account.

controls.description: Transient location and separate security domains reject public serialization and forbidden storage.

residualRisk.explanation: Production telemetry, providers, and participation stores require review.

threats.safeDegradation: Disable location/private writes and retain safe public directory reads.

threats.title: Generalized citizen reputation or political profile
threats.scenario: Narrow identity, moderation, location, or participation states are combined into a portable citizen value.

controls.description: Forbidden joins, names, exports, and agent outputs are rejected by foundation tests.

residualRisk.explanation: Future analytics, AI, and cross-product paths need issue #57 enforcement and review.

threats.safeDegradation: Reject the query, export, model, or integration and preserve narrow purpose-limited states only.

threats.title: Source poisoning, SSRF, or hostile content
threats.scenario: A malicious source or submitter targets internal networks, parsers, rights, or public record integrity.

controls.description: Synthetic connector retrieval revalidates origins and addresses, applies limits, and quarantines candidates.

residualRisk.explanation: Production egress sandbox, publishers, licences, and arbitrary-document controls are absent.

threats.safeDegradation: Disable retrieval and publication; mark source state unavailable or quarantined.

threats.title: AI fabrication, prompt injection, or private-data exfiltration
threats.scenario: An AI provider or hostile source causes fabricated civic output, tool escape, or restricted-data disclosure.

controls.description: AI has no human intent or publication authority and receives no private civic data.

residualRisk.explanation: No provider, isolation gateway, or adversarial evaluation is approved.

threats.safeDegradation: Disable AI and use a manual queue or unavailable state.

threats.title: Moderation capture, doxxing, or false publication
threats.scenario: Conflicted reviewers or malicious submissions bypass due process or expose protected material.

controls.description: Explicit human states, conflict recusal, public history, emergency restriction, and independent appeal are required.

residualRisk.explanation: No staffed operational queue or independent exercise exists.

threats.safeDegradation: Close intake and publication while existing reviewed public history remains available.

threats.title: Native build or signing supply-chain compromise
threats.scenario: A dependency, CI action, signing key, artifact, or update channel is compromised.

controls.description: Pinned toolchains, lockfile, SBOM, unsigned development builds, and configuration checks run in CI.

residualRisk.explanation: Production app signing, store release, rollback, and recovery evidence do not exist.

threats.safeDegradation: Stop release and rebuild only after dependency, credential, and artifact review.

threats.title: Malicious link, insecure storage, clipboard, or push leakage
threats.scenario: A synthetic attacker substitutes an app/wallet link or obtains session/political data from device or notification state.

controls.description: Exact links, explicit wallet gesture, protected-storage ports, clear-all behavior, and opaque push payloads are tested.

residualRisk.explanation: Associated-domain, device lifecycle, clipboard/screenshot, and provider tests remain manual/future.

threats.safeDegradation: Reject the link, clear local state, disable push/wallet launch, and allow safe in-app public reads.

threats.title: Forged, replayed, wrong-chain, or wrong-audience wallet proof
threats.scenario: A wallet/deep-link attacker or compromised signer returns a response outside the exact challenge context.

controls.description: Nonce, expiry, audience, purpose, network, session, signatures, current identity state, and compatibility must all verify.

residualRisk.explanation: The disabled mobile harness does not perform cryptographic wallet verification.

threats.safeDegradation: Create no link and preserve local account and public read paths.

threats.title: Unsafe representative-controlled identity update
threats.scenario: A hidden or wrong-network payload is bundled with login or accepted without exact consent and readback.

controls.description: The initial RMR-managed model does not authorize representative-controlled identity updates.

residualRisk.explanation: The safest current control is absence; a new governance issue is required to revive the path.

threats.safeDegradation: Keep the feature absent; canonical profiles and local corrections remain available.

threats.title: Wrong representative identity, parent, namespace, or custody
threats.scenario: An operator or compromised signer provisions a collision, wrong parent, duplicate identity, or unsafe authority.

controls.description: Issues #80-#82 require deterministic hierarchy, collision checks, reviewed batches, separate custody, idempotency, and readback.

residualRisk.explanation: Hierarchy, custody, recovery, runbooks, and write adapters are not approved.

threats.safeDegradation: Provision nothing and keep canonical public profiles independent of Verus.

threats.title: Signer/RPC compromise, reorg, content overwrite, or provenance-as-truth
threats.scenario: A compromised node or operator writes wrong bytes/network or labels a mismatch as verified truth.

controls.description: Signer/RPC domains are isolated, gates are false, and provenance explicitly does not prove truth.

residualRisk.explanation: VDXF namespace, exact-byte pipeline, signer/node faults, readback, and recovery are not implemented.

threats.safeDegradation: Perform no write and show accurate pending/unavailable provenance while canonical reads remain.

threats.title: Operator error, secret exposure, unsafe backup, or failed recovery
threats.scenario: A broad grant, wrong environment, copied secret, backup, telemetry, or destructive retry crosses a security boundary.

controls.description: Deny-by-default roles, redaction, secret scan, synthetic backup manifest, outbox, and VRSCTEST defaults exist.

residualRisk.explanation: Production secret management, restore, rotation, on-call, and incident exercises are pending.

threats.safeDegradation: Disable affected writes/exports, rotate or revoke, and preserve classified audit evidence.

threats.title: Scraping, defacement, registry capture, or public-memory manipulation
threats.scenario: A scraper or coordinated actor distorts, suppresses, or over-enumerates source-backed public records and corrections.

controls.description: Public profiles are source-backed allowlists with versioned timelines, coverage, corrections, and explicit missing-data meaning.

residualRisk.explanation: Public records are intentionally enumerable; availability, abuse, and editorial monitoring need production evidence.

threats.safeDegradation: Preserve proportionate public access, label gaps, and append corrections without hidden rewriting.

releaseReadiness.decisionReason: Synthetic foundation controls exist, but named owners, independent reviews, production exercises, and unresolved high-risk decisions remain incomplete.
